source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Reciprocal verbs in Sakha and the lexicon/syntax dichotomy
notes: As for discontinuous reciprocals (57) and reciprocal verbs in the singular (58), Siloni assumes that these realize the default option. Reciprocal verbs are intransitives derived in the lexicon and hence, they can realize in the singular, just like any intransitive verb (61a). This accounts for (58). They can also utilize the same mechanism of augmenting the singular subject with a with-phrase available to verbs in general (61b). This derives discontinuous reciprocals (57).
